description: Allowed import directions between the folders of src/ (stories #42, #55). A folder is the first directory under src/, or the first two under the areas in `twoLevelAreas`. Checked by test/tooling/dependencyDirection.test.cjs; `node test/tooling/folderDependencies.cjs` prints the measured matrix. When files move, rewrite this file, not the test.
layersNote: Top to bottom: a folder may import its own layer or a lower one, never a higher one, and a feature never imports another feature. Folders outside these areas (the pre-#55 tree, `(root)`) are not ranked. Each exception needs a reason.

twoWayPairs.active_servers<->code_analysis: Stopping a server closes its analysis session (active_servers/runtime/serverControl.ts -> code_analysis sessionRegistry), and the analysis watchers follow server removal (code_analysis/services/serverWatcherIntegration.ts -> the active-server registry and ServerControl). Both sides are the analysis<->server pair of docs/cleanup/src-layout.md §3.5; breaking it needs an event or callback seam, which is story #13 territory.
twoWayPairs.active_servers<->core/remote-access: The active-server model and registry carry RemoteAccessState (types from core/remote-access/remoteAccessModel.ts), and RemoteAccessManager watches the registry to stop a tunnel when its server goes. In src-layout.md the registry joins core/server, so this becomes the core server<->remote-access pair.
twoWayPairs.active_servers<->servers: The running-server registry (active_servers) and the server runtime (servers) are one subsystem split in two folders: the launcher registers servers and opens previews through active_servers, ServerControl stops them through the SSE manager. src-layout.md merges the registry, registrar and ServerControl into core/server; what then remains is the one upward edge multiServerLauncher -> launchNotifications (a view), allow-listed there.
twoWayPairs.code_analysis<->servers: The analysis bridges are hosted by the HTTP server (servers/runtime/analysis/* -> code_analysis historical, dependencies, refresh, watchers), and the analysis engine launches and notifies servers (serverLaunchOrchestrator, SSE). The analysis<->server pair of src-layout.md §3.5; inverting it means registering the bridges from the analysis side (#13).
twoWayPairs.core/remote-access<->servers: The servers authorize remote requests with RemoteSessionAuthority and the remote-access model (servers -> core/remote-access), and RemoteAccessManager reads and turns off the cross-network setting through ServerSettingsManager (core/remote-access -> servers, 1 edge). Breaking it needs that setting behind an injected accessor (#13).

vscodeFreeNote: src files from which no import path reaches `vscode` (type imports included). 97 when #42 started; may only go up. Raise the floor when it does. #55 batch 0 lowered it 109 -> 106 only because three vscode-free re-export barrels were deleted (configuration/models, customComponents, refresh index.ts); no surviving file lost the property.
